    char input[2101];
    cin >> input;
    int n = strlen(input);
    
    // Replace "dot" with "."
    for (int i = 1; i < n - 3; ++i) {
        if (input[i] == 'd') {
            if (input[i+1] == 'o' && input[i+2] == 't') {
                input[i] = '.';
                i += 2;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Replace "at" with "@"
    for (int i = 1; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if (input[i] == 'a') {
            if (input[i+1] == 't') {
                input[i] = '@';
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Output with skipping logic

        cout << input[i];
        if (input[i] == '.') {
            i += 3;
        } else if (input[i] == '@') {
            i += 2;
        } else {
            ++i;
        }
    }
    cout << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
